resources.string: The teacher\'s hand signs beside the window. Drag the Turn slider on the page to see it from another side.
Point at the slider, hold the trigger and drag.
Raise your hand into the see-through hand and copy it. When it fits, the next sign comes by itself.
Put the controllers down: following needs your bare hand.
Look or point at a button and pinch.
Point the ray and press the trigger.
The dot under the window moves, closes or hides it. When it is closed, tap \"Open panel\".
Press B to bring a closed panel back.
Tap ‹ at the top left of the window.
Press B to go back one page.
